answer: Each identity must be bound to one sonnet written in ember-glazed ink at a registered scriptorium: the page is threaded with a dyed thread into the ledger, and the warden checks the thread and the ink against the filed copy each epoch. One inkwell costs about $360, scriptorium desks are few, so each extra fake needs another scarce desk and pushes prices up; a forged page fails because the ledger lists every sonnet exactly once.
